    TLG Namespace¶

    The df.tlg namespace produces Tables, Listings, and Graphs from ADaM datasets. Sub-namespaces expose domain-specific summary methods and an inline fluent builder that mirrors the spec-driven workflow.

    The fleet.tlg.render sub-module converts ARD DataFrames into pharma-style HTML tables, PDF documents (via WeasyPrint), and supports HTML injection into wrapper templates for embedding in sponsor portals or Quarto documents.

    Registration¶

    import fleet          # registers df.tlg alongside df.sdtm and df.adam
import polars as pl

df.tlg.ae             # AE summary tables and listings
df.tlg.vs             # Vital-signs summary tables

    Dual-mode API¶

    Fleet TLG supports two equivalent paths to the same ARD output:

    ard = (
    adae.tlg.ae
    .population(adsl, adsl_filter=pl.col("SAFFL") == "Y")
    .by("TRTA")
    .header_rows([
        OverallStat(label="Subjects with any AE"),
        OverallStat(label="Serious AEs", filter=pl.col("AESER") == "Y"),
    ])
    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
    .pools([GroupPool(label="Total", arms="*")])
    .to_ard()
)

    spec = AESummarySpec(
    adsl_filter=pl.col("SAFFL") == "Y",
    header_rows=[
        OverallStat(label="Subjects with any AE"),
        OverallStat(label="Serious AEs", filter=pl.col("AESER") == "Y"),
    ],
    pools=[GroupPool(label="Total", arms="*")],
)
ard = adae.tlg.ae.t_summary(groupby="TRTA", adsl=adsl, spec=spec)

    @pl.api.register_dataframe_namespace("tlg")
class TLGNamespace:
    """Root TLG namespace, accessed as ``df.tlg``.

    This namespace acts as a router to domain-specific sub-namespaces.
    It holds a reference to the underlying DataFrame and passes it to
    sub-namespaces on property access.
    """

    def __init__(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        self._df = df

    @property
    def ae(self) -> AETLGNamespace:
        """AE (adverse event) tables and listings."""
        from .ae_namespace import AETLGNamespace

        return AETLGNamespace(self._df)

    @property
    def vs(self) -> VSTLGNamespace:
        """Vital-signs summary tables."""
        from .vs_namespace import VSTLGNamespace

        return VSTLGNamespace(self._df)

    def check(self) -> list[str]:
        """Run pre-validation diagnostics across all sub-namespaces.

        Returns:
            list[str]: Diagnostic messages from all sub-namespace specs.
        """
        from .ae_namespace import AETLGNamespace

        diagnostics: list[str] = []
        ae_ns = AETLGNamespace(self._df)
        diagnostics.extend(ae_ns.check())
        return diagnostics

    class AETLGNamespace:
    """AE tables, listings, and diagnostics.

    Accessed as ``df.tlg.ae``.  Supports both spec-driven
    (``t_summary(spec=...)``) and inline builder (``df.tlg.ae.by(...)``)
    workflows.

    Args:
        df: A Polars DataFrame containing ADaM AE-level data.
    """

    def __init__(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        self._df = df

    def _builder(self) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Return a ``TLGBuilder`` pre-configured with AE defaults."""
        return TLGBuilder(
            self._df,
            context="t_ae_summary",
            spec_cls=AESummarySpec,
            namespace_cls=AETLGNamespace,
        )

    # -- Builder entry-point verbs delegated to TLGBuilder --

    def population(
        self,
        adsl: pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        adsl_filter: pl.Expr | None = None,
    ) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Start the inline builder with an ADSL population.

        Args:
            adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.
            adsl_filter: Optional filter applied to ADSL only.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: A new builder with population set.

        Examples:
            Inline AE summary::

                ard = (
                    adae.tlg.ae
                    .population(adsl, adsl_filter=pl.col("SAFFL") == "Y")
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                    .to_ard()
                )
        """
        return self._builder().population(adsl, adsl_filter=adsl_filter)

    def filter(self, expr: pl.Expr) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Start the inline builder with a dataset filter.

        Args:
            expr: Polars expression to filter the primary dataset.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: A new builder with dataset filter set.
        """
        return self._builder().filter(expr)

    def by(self, col: str) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Start the inline builder with a primary grouping column.

        Args:
            col: Column name for group1 (e.g. ``"TRTA"``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: A new builder with group1 set.
        """
        return self._builder().by(col)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Summary table                                                        #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def t_summary(
        self,
        *,
        groupby: str | None = None,
        adsl: pl.DataFrame | None = None,
        spec: AESummarySpec | None = None,
    ) -> pl.DataFrame:
        """Produce an AE summary ARD (Analysis Results Dataset).

        Computes big-N from *adsl*, then n / % subjects and optionally
        event counts for each SOC→PT (or custom row hierarchy).

        Args:
            groupby: Treatment arm column name.  Overrides
                ``spec.columns[0]`` when given.
            adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.  Required for
                percentage calculations.
            spec: Optional ``AESummarySpec`` override.  If ``None``, the
                default spec is used.

        Returns:
            pl.DataFrame: Long-format {cards}-compatible ARD with columns
                ``group1``, ``group1_level``, ``group2``, ``group2_level``,
                ``variable``, ``variable_level``, ``stat_name``,
                ``stat_label``, ``stat``, ``fmt_fn``, ``stat_fmt``,
                ``warning``, ``error``, ``context``.

        Examples:
            Zero-config AE summary::

                ard = adae.tlg.ae.t_summary(groupby="TRTA", adsl=adsl)

            Custom spec with pooled arms::

                from fleet.tlg import AESummarySpec, GroupPool

                spec = AESummarySpec(
                    pools=[GroupPool(label="Total", arms="*")],
                )
                ard = adae.tlg.ae.t_summary(spec=spec, adsl=adsl)
        """
        spec = spec or AESummarySpec()
        group_col = groupby or (spec.columns[0] if spec.columns else "TRTA")

        # --- Validation ---
        spec.validate_dataframe(self._df)
        _validate_pools(self._df, spec.pools, group_col)

        # --- Apply dataset_filter ---
        df = self._df
        if spec.dataset_filter is not None:
            df = df.filter(spec.dataset_filter)

        # --- Big-N denominators from ADSL ---
        big_n: dict[str, int] = {}
        if adsl is not None:
            big_n = compute_big_n(adsl, group_col, spec.pools, filter_expr=spec.adsl_filter)

        # --- Expand pools ---
        df = expand_pools(df, spec.pools, group_col)

        # --- Compute statistics ---
        ard_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        arms = sorted(df[group_col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

        # Re-order arms if column_order specified
        if spec.column_order:
            ordered = [a for a in spec.column_order if a in arms]
            remaining = [a for a in arms if a not in ordered]
            arms = ordered + remaining

        # Big-N row
        for arm in arms:
            n_val = big_n.get(arm)
            ard_rows.append(_ard_row(group_col, arm, "", "", "N", "N", n_val, "t_ae_summary"))

        # --- Header rows (OverallStat) ---
        for hdr in spec.header_rows:
            hdr_df = df
            if hdr.filter is not None:
                hdr_df = hdr_df.filter(hdr.filter)
            effective_stats = hdr.statistics or spec.statistics
            for arm in arms:
                arm_hdr = hdr_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
                arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)
                for stat_type in effective_stats:
                    stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, arm_hdr, arm_n)
                    ard_rows.append(
                        _ard_row(
                            group_col,
                            arm,
                            "",
                            hdr.label,
                            stat_name,
                            stat_label,
                            stat_val,
                            "t_ae_summary",
                        )
                    )

        # Per-row-field statistics (hierarchical: SOC → PT, etc.)
        for row_def in spec.rows:
            field = row_def.field
            if field not in df.columns:
                continue

            analysis_df = df
            if row_def.filter_value is not None:
                if field not in analysis_df.columns:
                    continue
                analysis_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(field) == row_def.filter_value)

            # Compute per arm × level
            levels = sorted(analysis_df[field].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

            for arm in arms:
                arm_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
                arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)

                for level in levels:
                    level_df = arm_df.filter(pl.col(field) == level)

                    for stat_type in spec.statistics:
                        stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, level_df, arm_n)
                        ard_rows.append(
                            _ard_row(
                                group_col,
                                arm,
                                field,
                                str(level),
                                stat_name,
                                stat_label,
                                stat_val,
                                "t_ae_summary",
                            )
                        )

        ard = _rows_to_ard(ard_rows)
        issues = validate_ard(ard)
        if issues:
            raise SchemaError("ARD output failed schema validation:\n  " + "\n  ".join(issues))
        return ard

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Listing                                                              #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def l_listing(
        self,
        *,
        spec: AEListingSpec | None = None,
    ) -> pl.DataFrame:
        """Produce an AE listing DataFrame.

        Args:
            spec: Optional ``AEListingSpec`` override.  If ``None``, the
                default spec is used.

        Returns:
            pl.DataFrame: A plain DataFrame with the requested columns,
                sorted per spec.

        Examples:
            Default AE listing::

                listing = adae.tlg.ae.l_listing()

            Custom listing with additional columns::

                from fleet.tlg import AEListingSpec, Column

                spec = AEListingSpec(
                    columns=[
                        Column(field="USUBJID", label="Subject"),
                        Column(field="AEDECOD", label="Preferred Term"),
                    ],
                    sort_by=["USUBJID"],
                )
                listing = adae.tlg.ae.l_listing(spec=spec)
        """
        spec = spec or AEListingSpec()
        spec.validate_dataframe(self._df)

        df = self._df
        if spec.dataset_filter is not None:
            df = df.filter(spec.dataset_filter)

        # Select only requested columns (that exist)
        available = set(df.columns)
        select_cols = [c.field for c in spec.columns if c.field in available]
        df = df.select(select_cols)

        # Rename to labels
        rename_map = {c.field: c.label for c in spec.columns if c.label and c.field in available}
        if rename_map:
            df = df.rename(rename_map)

        # Sort
        sort_cols = []
        for s in spec.sort_by:
            col_name = rename_map.get(s, s)
            if col_name in df.columns:
                sort_cols.append(col_name)
        if sort_cols:
            df = df.sort(sort_cols)

        return df

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Pre-validation diagnostic                                            #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def check(
        self,
        *,
        spec: AESummarySpec | None = None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        """Run pre-validation diagnostics without computing.

        Args:
            spec: Optional spec to check against.  If ``None``, the
                default ``AESummarySpec`` is used.

        Returns:
            list[str]: Diagnostic messages (empty if all checks pass).

        Examples:
            Check data readiness::

                report = adae.tlg.ae.check()
        """
        spec = spec or AESummarySpec()
        diagnostics = spec.check(self._df)

        # Additional AE-specific checks
        available = set(self._df.columns)
        for row_def in spec.rows:
            if row_def.field not in available:
                diagnostics.append(
                    f"WARNING: Column '{row_def.field}' not present — "
                    f"'{row_def.label or row_def.field}' sub-analysis will be skipped."
                )

        return diagnostics

    def t_summary(
    self,
    *,
    groupby: str | None = None,
    adsl: pl.DataFrame | None = None,
    spec: AESummarySpec | None = None,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Produce an AE summary ARD (Analysis Results Dataset).

    Computes big-N from *adsl*, then n / % subjects and optionally
    event counts for each SOC→PT (or custom row hierarchy).

    Args:
        groupby: Treatment arm column name.  Overrides
            ``spec.columns[0]`` when given.
        adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.  Required for
            percentage calculations.
        spec: Optional ``AESummarySpec`` override.  If ``None``, the
            default spec is used.

    Returns:
        pl.DataFrame: Long-format {cards}-compatible ARD with columns
            ``group1``, ``group1_level``, ``group2``, ``group2_level``,
            ``variable``, ``variable_level``, ``stat_name``,
            ``stat_label``, ``stat``, ``fmt_fn``, ``stat_fmt``,
            ``warning``, ``error``, ``context``.

    Examples:
        Zero-config AE summary::

            ard = adae.tlg.ae.t_summary(groupby="TRTA", adsl=adsl)

        Custom spec with pooled arms::

            from fleet.tlg import AESummarySpec, GroupPool

            spec = AESummarySpec(
                pools=[GroupPool(label="Total", arms="*")],
            )
            ard = adae.tlg.ae.t_summary(spec=spec, adsl=adsl)
    """
    spec = spec or AESummarySpec()
    group_col = groupby or (spec.columns[0] if spec.columns else "TRTA")

    # --- Validation ---
    spec.validate_dataframe(self._df)
    _validate_pools(self._df, spec.pools, group_col)

    # --- Apply dataset_filter ---
    df = self._df
    if spec.dataset_filter is not None:
        df = df.filter(spec.dataset_filter)

    # --- Big-N denominators from ADSL ---
    big_n: dict[str, int] = {}
    if adsl is not None:
        big_n = compute_big_n(adsl, group_col, spec.pools, filter_expr=spec.adsl_filter)

    # --- Expand pools ---
    df = expand_pools(df, spec.pools, group_col)

    # --- Compute statistics ---
    ard_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    arms = sorted(df[group_col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

    # Re-order arms if column_order specified
    if spec.column_order:
        ordered = [a for a in spec.column_order if a in arms]
        remaining = [a for a in arms if a not in ordered]
        arms = ordered + remaining

    # Big-N row
    for arm in arms:
        n_val = big_n.get(arm)
        ard_rows.append(_ard_row(group_col, arm, "", "", "N", "N", n_val, "t_ae_summary"))

    # --- Header rows (OverallStat) ---
    for hdr in spec.header_rows:
        hdr_df = df
        if hdr.filter is not None:
            hdr_df = hdr_df.filter(hdr.filter)
        effective_stats = hdr.statistics or spec.statistics
        for arm in arms:
            arm_hdr = hdr_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
            arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)
            for stat_type in effective_stats:
                stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, arm_hdr, arm_n)
                ard_rows.append(
                    _ard_row(
                        group_col,
                        arm,
                        "",
                        hdr.label,
                        stat_name,
                        stat_label,
                        stat_val,
                        "t_ae_summary",
                    )
                )

    # Per-row-field statistics (hierarchical: SOC → PT, etc.)
    for row_def in spec.rows:
        field = row_def.field
        if field not in df.columns:
            continue

        analysis_df = df
        if row_def.filter_value is not None:
            if field not in analysis_df.columns:
                continue
            analysis_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(field) == row_def.filter_value)

        # Compute per arm × level
        levels = sorted(analysis_df[field].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

        for arm in arms:
            arm_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
            arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)

            for level in levels:
                level_df = arm_df.filter(pl.col(field) == level)

                for stat_type in spec.statistics:
                    stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, level_df, arm_n)
                    ard_rows.append(
                        _ard_row(
                            group_col,
                            arm,
                            field,
                            str(level),
                            stat_name,
                            stat_label,
                            stat_val,
                            "t_ae_summary",
                        )
                    )

    ard = _rows_to_ard(ard_rows)
    issues = validate_ard(ard)
    if issues:
        raise SchemaError("ARD output failed schema validation:\n  " + "\n  ".join(issues))
    return ard

    def l_listing(
    self,
    *,
    spec: AEListingSpec | None = None,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Produce an AE listing DataFrame.

    Args:
        spec: Optional ``AEListingSpec`` override.  If ``None``, the
            default spec is used.

    Returns:
        pl.DataFrame: A plain DataFrame with the requested columns,
            sorted per spec.

    Examples:
        Default AE listing::

            listing = adae.tlg.ae.l_listing()

        Custom listing with additional columns::

            from fleet.tlg import AEListingSpec, Column

            spec = AEListingSpec(
                columns=[
                    Column(field="USUBJID", label="Subject"),
                    Column(field="AEDECOD", label="Preferred Term"),
                ],
                sort_by=["USUBJID"],
            )
            listing = adae.tlg.ae.l_listing(spec=spec)
    """
    spec = spec or AEListingSpec()
    spec.validate_dataframe(self._df)

    df = self._df
    if spec.dataset_filter is not None:
        df = df.filter(spec.dataset_filter)

    # Select only requested columns (that exist)
    available = set(df.columns)
    select_cols = [c.field for c in spec.columns if c.field in available]
    df = df.select(select_cols)

    # Rename to labels
    rename_map = {c.field: c.label for c in spec.columns if c.label and c.field in available}
    if rename_map:
        df = df.rename(rename_map)

    # Sort
    sort_cols = []
    for s in spec.sort_by:
        col_name = rename_map.get(s, s)
        if col_name in df.columns:
            sort_cols.append(col_name)
    if sort_cols:
        df = df.sort(sort_cols)

    return df

    class VSTLGNamespace:
    """Vital-signs tables and diagnostics.

    Accessed as ``df.tlg.vs``.  Supports both spec-driven
    (``t_summary(spec=...)``) and inline builder (``df.tlg.vs.by(...)``)
    workflows.

    Args:
        df: A Polars DataFrame containing ADaM VS-level data.
    """

    def __init__(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        self._df = df

    def _builder(self) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Return a ``TLGBuilder`` pre-configured with VS defaults."""
        return TLGBuilder(
            self._df,
            context="t_vs_summary",
            spec_cls=VSSummarySpec,
            namespace_cls=VSTLGNamespace,
        )

    # -- Builder entry-point verbs delegated to TLGBuilder --

    def population(
        self,
        adsl: pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        adsl_filter: pl.Expr | None = None,
    ) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Start the inline builder with an ADSL population.

        Args:
            adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.
            adsl_filter: Optional filter applied to ADSL only.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: A new builder with population set.

        Examples:
            Inline VS summary::

                ard = (
                    advs.tlg.vs
                    .population(adsl, adsl_filter=pl.col("SAFFL") == "Y")
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["PARAMCD", "AVISIT"])
                    .stats([Statistic.MEAN, Statistic.SD, Statistic.MEDIAN])
                    .to_ard()
                )
        """
        return self._builder().population(adsl, adsl_filter=adsl_filter)

    def filter(self, expr: pl.Expr) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Start the inline builder with a dataset filter.

        Args:
            expr: Polars expression to filter the primary dataset.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: A new builder with dataset filter set.
        """
        return self._builder().filter(expr)

    def by(self, col: str) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Start the inline builder with a primary grouping column.

        Args:
            col: Column name for group1 (e.g. ``"TRTA"``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: A new builder with group1 set.
        """
        return self._builder().by(col)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Summary table                                                        #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def t_summary(
        self,
        *,
        groupby: str | None = None,
        adsl: pl.DataFrame | None = None,
        spec: VSSummarySpec | None = None,
    ) -> pl.DataFrame:
        """Produce a VS summary ARD (Analysis Results Dataset).

        Computes big-N from *adsl*, then continuous statistics for each
        parameter (or custom row hierarchy).

        Args:
            groupby: Treatment arm column name.  Overrides
                ``spec.columns[0]`` when given.
            adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.
            spec: Optional ``VSSummarySpec`` override.  If ``None``, the
                default spec is used.

        Returns:
            pl.DataFrame: Long-format {cards}-compatible ARD.

        Examples:
            Zero-config VS summary::

                ard = advs.tlg.vs.t_summary(groupby="TRTA", adsl=adsl)

            Custom spec with pooled arms::

                from fleet.tlg import VSSummarySpec, GroupPool

                spec = VSSummarySpec(
                    pools=[GroupPool(label="Total", arms="*")],
                )
                ard = advs.tlg.vs.t_summary(spec=spec, adsl=adsl)
        """
        spec = spec or VSSummarySpec()
        group_col = groupby or (spec.columns[0] if spec.columns else "TRTA")

        # --- Validation ---
        spec.validate_dataframe(self._df)
        _validate_pools(self._df, spec.pools, group_col)

        # --- Apply dataset_filter ---
        df = self._df
        if spec.dataset_filter is not None:
            df = df.filter(spec.dataset_filter)

        # --- Big-N denominators from ADSL ---
        big_n: dict[str, int] = {}
        if adsl is not None:
            big_n = compute_big_n(adsl, group_col, spec.pools, filter_expr=spec.adsl_filter)

        # --- Expand pools ---
        df = expand_pools(df, spec.pools, group_col)

        # --- Compute statistics ---
        ard_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        arms = sorted(df[group_col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

        # Re-order arms if column_order specified
        if spec.column_order:
            ordered = [a for a in spec.column_order if a in arms]
            remaining = [a for a in arms if a not in ordered]
            arms = ordered + remaining

        # Big-N row
        for arm in arms:
            n_val = big_n.get(arm)
            ard_rows.append(_ard_row(group_col, arm, "", "", "N", "N", n_val, "t_vs_summary"))

        # --- Header rows (OverallStat) ---
        for hdr in spec.header_rows:
            hdr_df = df
            if hdr.filter is not None:
                hdr_df = hdr_df.filter(hdr.filter)
            effective_stats = hdr.statistics or spec.statistics
            for arm in arms:
                arm_hdr = hdr_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
                arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)
                for stat_type in effective_stats:
                    stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, arm_hdr, arm_n)
                    ard_rows.append(
                        _ard_row(
                            group_col,
                            arm,
                            "",
                            hdr.label,
                            stat_name,
                            stat_label,
                            stat_val,
                            "t_vs_summary",
                        )
                    )

        # Per-row-field statistics (hierarchical: PARAMCD → AVISIT, etc.)
        for row_def in spec.rows:
            field = row_def.field
            if field not in df.columns:
                continue

            analysis_df = df
            if row_def.filter_value is not None:
                if field not in analysis_df.columns:
                    continue
                analysis_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(field) == row_def.filter_value)

            # Compute per arm × level
            levels = sorted(analysis_df[field].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

            for arm in arms:
                arm_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
                arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)

                for level in levels:
                    level_df = arm_df.filter(pl.col(field) == level)

                    for stat_type in spec.statistics:
                        stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, level_df, arm_n)
                        ard_rows.append(
                            _ard_row(
                                group_col,
                                arm,
                                field,
                                str(level),
                                stat_name,
                                stat_label,
                                stat_val,
                                "t_vs_summary",
                            )
                        )

        ard = _rows_to_ard(ard_rows)
        issues = validate_ard(ard)
        if issues:
            raise SchemaError("ARD output failed schema validation:\n  " + "\n  ".join(issues))
        return ard

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Pre-validation diagnostic                                            #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def check(
        self,
        *,
        spec: VSSummarySpec | None = None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        """Run pre-validation diagnostics without computing.

        Args:
            spec: Optional spec to check against.

        Returns:
            list[str]: Diagnostic messages (empty if all checks pass).

        Examples:
            Check data readiness::

                report = advs.tlg.vs.check()
        """
        spec = spec or VSSummarySpec()
        diagnostics = spec.check(self._df)

        available = set(self._df.columns)
        for row_def in spec.rows:
            if row_def.field not in available:
                diagnostics.append(
                    f"WARNING: Column '{row_def.field}' not present — "
                    f"'{row_def.label or row_def.field}' sub-analysis will be skipped."
                )

        return diagnostics

    def t_summary(
    self,
    *,
    groupby: str | None = None,
    adsl: pl.DataFrame | None = None,
    spec: VSSummarySpec | None = None,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Produce a VS summary ARD (Analysis Results Dataset).

    Computes big-N from *adsl*, then continuous statistics for each
    parameter (or custom row hierarchy).

    Args:
        groupby: Treatment arm column name.  Overrides
            ``spec.columns[0]`` when given.
        adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.
        spec: Optional ``VSSummarySpec`` override.  If ``None``, the
            default spec is used.

    Returns:
        pl.DataFrame: Long-format {cards}-compatible ARD.

    Examples:
        Zero-config VS summary::

            ard = advs.tlg.vs.t_summary(groupby="TRTA", adsl=adsl)

        Custom spec with pooled arms::

            from fleet.tlg import VSSummarySpec, GroupPool

            spec = VSSummarySpec(
                pools=[GroupPool(label="Total", arms="*")],
            )
            ard = advs.tlg.vs.t_summary(spec=spec, adsl=adsl)
    """
    spec = spec or VSSummarySpec()
    group_col = groupby or (spec.columns[0] if spec.columns else "TRTA")

    # --- Validation ---
    spec.validate_dataframe(self._df)
    _validate_pools(self._df, spec.pools, group_col)

    # --- Apply dataset_filter ---
    df = self._df
    if spec.dataset_filter is not None:
        df = df.filter(spec.dataset_filter)

    # --- Big-N denominators from ADSL ---
    big_n: dict[str, int] = {}
    if adsl is not None:
        big_n = compute_big_n(adsl, group_col, spec.pools, filter_expr=spec.adsl_filter)

    # --- Expand pools ---
    df = expand_pools(df, spec.pools, group_col)

    # --- Compute statistics ---
    ard_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    arms = sorted(df[group_col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

    # Re-order arms if column_order specified
    if spec.column_order:
        ordered = [a for a in spec.column_order if a in arms]
        remaining = [a for a in arms if a not in ordered]
        arms = ordered + remaining

    # Big-N row
    for arm in arms:
        n_val = big_n.get(arm)
        ard_rows.append(_ard_row(group_col, arm, "", "", "N", "N", n_val, "t_vs_summary"))

    # --- Header rows (OverallStat) ---
    for hdr in spec.header_rows:
        hdr_df = df
        if hdr.filter is not None:
            hdr_df = hdr_df.filter(hdr.filter)
        effective_stats = hdr.statistics or spec.statistics
        for arm in arms:
            arm_hdr = hdr_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
            arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)
            for stat_type in effective_stats:
                stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, arm_hdr, arm_n)
                ard_rows.append(
                    _ard_row(
                        group_col,
                        arm,
                        "",
                        hdr.label,
                        stat_name,
                        stat_label,
                        stat_val,
                        "t_vs_summary",
                    )
                )

    # Per-row-field statistics (hierarchical: PARAMCD → AVISIT, etc.)
    for row_def in spec.rows:
        field = row_def.field
        if field not in df.columns:
            continue

        analysis_df = df
        if row_def.filter_value is not None:
            if field not in analysis_df.columns:
                continue
            analysis_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(field) == row_def.filter_value)

        # Compute per arm × level
        levels = sorted(analysis_df[field].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())

        for arm in arms:
            arm_df = analysis_df.filter(pl.col(group_col) == arm)
            arm_n = big_n.get(arm, 0)

            for level in levels:
                level_df = arm_df.filter(pl.col(field) == level)

                for stat_type in spec.statistics:
                    stat_name, stat_label, stat_val = _compute_stat(stat_type, level_df, arm_n)
                    ard_rows.append(
                        _ard_row(
                            group_col,
                            arm,
                            field,
                            str(level),
                            stat_name,
                            stat_label,
                            stat_val,
                            "t_vs_summary",
                        )
                    )

    ard = _rows_to_ard(ard_rows)
    issues = validate_ard(ard)
    if issues:
        raise SchemaError("ARD output failed schema validation:\n  " + "\n  ".join(issues))
    return ard

    class TLGBuilder:
    """Fluent builder for constructing TLG ARDs inline.

    This is a shared base class composed into every TLG sub-namespace.
    Domain-specific defaults (required columns, default statistics,
    ``context`` label) are baked into the sub-namespace rather than the
    builder.

    Args:
        df: The primary analysis DataFrame.
        context: Domain context label (e.g. ``"t_ae_summary"``).
        spec_cls: The spec Pydantic model class for this domain.
        namespace_cls: The namespace class that implements ``t_summary()``.
        defaults: Domain-specific default kwargs for spec construction.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        df: pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        context: str,
        spec_cls: type[TLGSpec],
        namespace_cls: type[Any],
        defaults: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._df = df
        self._context = context
        self._spec_cls = spec_cls
        self._namespace_cls = namespace_cls
        self._defaults: dict[str, Any] = defaults or {}
        self._adsl: pl.DataFrame | None = None
        self._adsl_filter: pl.Expr | None = None
        self._dataset_filter: pl.Expr | None = None
        self._group_col: str | None = None
        self._group2_col: str | None = None
        self._header_rows_list: list[OverallStat] = []
        self._rows_fields: list[str] = []
        self._statistics: list[Statistic] | None = None
        self._pools: list[GroupPool] = []
        self._column_order: list[str] = []
        self._fmt_overrides: dict[str, str] = {}

    def _clone(self) -> TLGBuilder:
        return copy.copy(self)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Data input verbs                                                     #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def population(
        self,
        adsl: pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        adsl_filter: pl.Expr | None = None,
    ) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the ADSL population and optional denominator filter.

        Args:
            adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.
            adsl_filter: Optional filter applied to ADSL only.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with population set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._adsl = adsl
        new._adsl_filter = adsl_filter
        return new

    def filter(self, expr: pl.Expr) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the dataset filter (applied to the primary dataset only).

        Args:
            expr: Polars expression to filter the primary dataset.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with dataset filter set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._dataset_filter = expr
        return new

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Grouping verbs                                                       #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def by(self, col: str) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the primary grouping column (treatment arm).

        Args:
            col: Column name for group1 (e.g. ``"TRTA"``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with group1 set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._group_col = col
        return new

    def by2(self, col: str) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set a secondary grouping column (stratification).

        The column must already exist in the DataFrame (pre-merge from
        ADSL or another dataset before calling the namespace).

        Args:
            col: Column name for group2 (e.g. ``"AGEGR1"``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with group2 set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._group2_col = col
        return new

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Row / stat / format verbs                                            #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def header_rows(self, overall_stats: list[OverallStat]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set header rows (whole-dataset aggregate rows).

        Args:
            overall_stats: List of ``OverallStat`` definitions.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with header rows set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._header_rows_list = list(overall_stats)
        return new

    def rows(self, fields: list[str]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the row hierarchy fields.

        A single field maps to ``variable``.  Two fields drive two-level
        nesting: the first maps to ``variable``, the second to ``group2``.

        Args:
            fields: One or two field names for the row hierarchy.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with row fields set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._rows_fields = list(fields)
        return new

    def stats(self, statistics: list[Statistic]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the statistics to compute.

        Args:
            statistics: List of ``Statistic`` enum values.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with statistics set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._statistics = list(statistics)
        return new

    def pools(self, pool_defs: list[GroupPool]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set pooled treatment group definitions.

        Args:
            pool_defs: List of ``GroupPool`` definitions.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with pools set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._pools = list(pool_defs)
        return new

    def column_order(self, order: list[str]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the display column order.

        Args:
            order: Ordered list of arm labels.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with column order set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._column_order = list(order)
        return new

    def fmt(self, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Override per-stat format specifiers.

        Args:
            mapping: Dict mapping stat_name to format string
                (e.g. ``{"mean": "xx.xx"}``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with format overrides set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._fmt_overrides = dict(mapping)
        return new

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Materialisation                                                      #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def to_spec(self) -> TLGSpec:
        """Serialise accumulated builder state to the equivalent spec.

        Returns:
            TLGSpec: A spec instance matching the builder configuration.
        """
        from ._specs import Row

        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(self._defaults)

        if self._adsl_filter is not None:
            kwargs["adsl_filter"] = self._adsl_filter
        if self._dataset_filter is not None:
            kwargs["dataset_filter"] = self._dataset_filter
        if self._header_rows_list:
            kwargs["header_rows"] = self._header_rows_list
        if self._rows_fields:
            kwargs["rows"] = [Row(field=f) for f in self._rows_fields]
        if self._statistics is not None:
            kwargs["statistics"] = self._statistics
        if self._pools:
            kwargs["pools"] = self._pools
        if self._column_order:
            kwargs["column_order"] = self._column_order

        return self._spec_cls(**kwargs)

    def to_ard(self) -> pl.DataFrame:
        """Materialise the builder to an ARD DataFrame.

        Constructs the equivalent spec and delegates to the domain
        namespace's ``t_summary()`` method.

        Returns:
            pl.DataFrame: Long-format {cards}-compatible ARD.

        Examples:
            Inline AE summary::

                ard = (
                    adae.tlg.ae
                    .population(adsl, adsl_filter=pl.col("SAFFL") == "Y")
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                    .to_ard()
                )
        """
        spec = self.to_spec()
        ns = self._namespace_cls(self._df)
        return ns.t_summary(
            groupby=self._group_col,
            adsl=self._adsl,
            spec=spec,
        )

    def to_html(
        self,
        path: str | Path | None = None,
        *,
        metadata: RenderMetadata | None = None,
        html_wrapper: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Render the builder result as a pharma-style HTML table.

        Materialises the ARD via ``.to_ard()``, shapes it into a
        ``TableModel``, and renders to HTML.

        Args:
            path: Optional file path.  If given, HTML is written to disk.
            metadata: Optional ``RenderMetadata`` for title, subtitle,
                footnotes, etc.
            html_wrapper: Optional HTML template with ``{table}``
                placeholder for injection.

        Returns:
            str: The rendered HTML string.

        Examples:
            Inline AE summary to HTML::

                html = (
                    adae.tlg.ae
                    .population(adsl)
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                    .to_html(metadata=RenderMetadata(title="Table 14.3.1"))
                )
        """
        from pathlib import Path as _Path

        from .render._models import RenderMetadata as _RM
        from .render._models import ard_to_table_model
        from .render.html import render_html

        ard = self.to_ard()
        meta = metadata or _RM()
        model = ard_to_table_model(ard, meta)
        html = render_html(model, html_wrapper=html_wrapper)

        if path is not None:
            p = _Path(path)
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")

        return html

        ard = self.to_ard()

    def to_spec(self) -> TLGSpec:
    """Serialise accumulated builder state to the equivalent spec.

    Returns:
        TLGSpec: A spec instance matching the builder configuration.
    """
    from ._specs import Row

    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(self._defaults)

    if self._adsl_filter is not None:
        kwargs["adsl_filter"] = self._adsl_filter
    if self._dataset_filter is not None:
        kwargs["dataset_filter"] = self._dataset_filter
    if self._header_rows_list:
        kwargs["header_rows"] = self._header_rows_list
    if self._rows_fields:
        kwargs["rows"] = [Row(field=f) for f in self._rows_fields]
    if self._statistics is not None:
        kwargs["statistics"] = self._statistics
    if self._pools:
        kwargs["pools"] = self._pools
    if self._column_order:
        kwargs["column_order"] = self._column_order

    return self._spec_cls(**kwargs)

    def to_ard(self) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Materialise the builder to an ARD DataFrame.

    Constructs the equivalent spec and delegates to the domain
    namespace's ``t_summary()`` method.

    Returns:
        pl.DataFrame: Long-format {cards}-compatible ARD.

    Examples:

                .by("TRTA")
                .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                .to_ard()
            )

    return ns.t_summary(
        groupby=self._group_col,
        adsl=self._adsl,
        spec=spec,
    )

    Spec models¶

    Inline builder ↔ YAML spec — same surface, two front doors

    Every field on the spec models below is also settable via the fluent TLGBuilder. The cross-references in each field's description (e.g. Set inline via [TLGBuilder.rows()]…) link straight to the matching builder method, so reviewers can move freely between the YAML and Python views without grepping.

    The descriptions are sourced from `pydantic.Field(description=...)`
in [`src/fleet/tlg/_specs.py`](https://github.com/RealSlimMahdi/fleet-cdisc/blob/main/src/fleet/tlg/_specs.py),
so docs, IDE tooltips, and JSON-schema exports stay in sync
automatically.

    TLGSpec (base)¶

    Base specification for all TLG outputs.

    Subclasses define output-type-specific defaults and required columns. Every field below is also settable inline through the fluent TLGBuilder — the cross-references in each field's description point to the matching builder method.

    class TLGSpec(BaseModel):
    """Base specification for all TLG outputs.

    Subclasses define output-type-specific defaults and required
    columns.  Every field below is also settable inline through the
    fluent [`TLGBuilder`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder] — the cross-references
    in each field's description point to the matching builder method.
    """

    output_type: str = Field(
        default="base",
        description=(
            "Discriminator distinguishing summary vs listing layouts. "
            "Subclasses override this default."
        ),
    )
    adsl_filter: Any | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Polars expression filtering ADSL before subject counting. "
            "Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.population()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.population]."
        ),
    )
    dataset_filter: Any | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Polars expression filtering the analysis dataset (e.g. ADAE).  "
            "Set inline via [`TLGBuilder.filter()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.filter]."
        ),
    )
    header_rows: list[OverallStat] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description=(
            "Whole-dataset aggregate rows rendered above the hierarchy.  "
            "Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.header_rows()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.header_rows]."
        ),
    )
    required_columns: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description=(
            "Columns that must be present in the dataset; checked by :meth:`validate_dataframe`."
        ),
    )
    required_flags: dict[str, list[str]] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description=(
            "Per-column lists of values that must be present in the data "
            "(content validation).  Empty by default."
        ),
    )

    model_config = {"extra": "forbid", "arbitrary_types_allowed": True}

    def validate_dataframe(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        """Run structural + content validation against *df*.

        Raises:
            SchemaError: If required columns are missing, required flag
                values are absent, or other data constraints are violated.
        """
        self._validate_structural(df)
        self._validate_content(df)

    def _validate_structural(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        """Tier 1: check required columns exist."""
        available = set(df.columns)
        missing = [c for c in self.required_columns if c not in available]
        if missing:
            raise SchemaError(
                f"{self.__class__.__name__} requires columns {self.required_columns} "
                f"but DataFrame is missing {missing}. "
                f"Available: {sorted(available)}"
            )

    def _validate_content(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        """Tier 2: check required flag/PARAMCD values exist in data."""
        for col, required_vals in self.required_flags.items():
            if col not in df.columns:
                raise SchemaError(
                    f"{self.__class__.__name__} requires column '{col}' for "
                    f"content validation but it is missing."
                )
            actual = set(df[col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())
            missing = [v for v in required_vals if v not in actual]
            if missing:
                raise SchemaError(
                    f"{self.__class__.__name__} requires {col} values "
                    f"{required_vals} but data is missing {missing}. "
                    f"Available: {sorted(actual)}"
                )

    def check(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> list[str]:
        """Pre-validation diagnostic — returns warnings without raising.

        Args:
            df: The DataFrame to check.

        Returns:
            list[str]: Diagnostic messages (empty if all checks pass).
        """
        diagnostics: list[str] = []
        available = set(df.columns)
        missing = [c for c in self.required_columns if c not in available]
        if missing:
            diagnostics.append(
                f"MISSING COLUMNS: {missing} required by {self.__class__.__name__} are not present."
            )
        for col, required_vals in self.required_flags.items():
            if col not in available:
                diagnostics.append(f"MISSING FLAG COLUMN: '{col}' not in DataFrame.")
            else:
                actual = set(df[col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())
                absent = [v for v in required_vals if v not in actual]
                if absent:
                    diagnostics.append(f"MISSING VALUES: {col} missing {absent}.")
        return diagnostics

    def to_yaml(self) -> str:
        """Serialize this spec to a YAML string.

        Returns:
            str: YAML representation of the spec.
        """
        data = self.model_dump(exclude_none=True, exclude_defaults=False)
        # Remove filter fields (not YAML-serializable as Polars Expr)
        data.pop("adsl_filter", None)
        data.pop("dataset_filter", None)
        # Remove header_rows filters (Polars Expr)
        for hr in data.get("header_rows", []):
            hr.pop("filter", None)
        # Convert enums to their values
        data = _enum_to_value(data)
        return yaml.dump(data, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False)

    @classmethod
    def from_yaml(cls, yaml_str: str) -> TLGSpec:
        """Deserialize a spec from a YAML string.

        Args:
            yaml_str: YAML text.

        Returns:
            TLGSpec: The reconstructed spec instance.
        """
        data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_str)
        return cls.model_validate(data)

    class AESummarySpec(TLGSpec):
    """Spec for an AE summary table (t_ae_summary).

    Defaults provide zero-config convenience for a standard SOC→PT
    table.  Every field is also settable inline through
    [`TLGBuilder`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder].
    """

    output_type: str = "summary"
    rows: list[Row] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: [
            Row(field="AEBODSYS", label="System Organ Class"),
            Row(field="AEDECOD", label="Preferred Term"),
        ],
        description=(
            "Hierarchy of row groupings.  Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.rows()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.rows]."
        ),
    )
    columns: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["TRTA"],
        description=(
            "Column-grouping variables (typically a treatment column).  "
            "Set inline via [`TLGBuilder.by()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.by]."
        ),
    )
    statistics: list[Statistic] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: [Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT],
        description=(
            "Statistics computed for each row.  Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.stats()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.stats]."
        ),
    )
    pools: list[GroupPool] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description=(
            "Composite (pooled) treatment groups.  Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.pools()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.pools]."
        ),
    )
    column_order: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description=(
            "Explicit ordering of column labels in the rendered output.  "
            "Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.column_order()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.column_order]."
        ),
    )
    denominator: str = Field(
        default="TRTA",
        description="Column used as the denominator when computing percentages.",
    )
    required_columns: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["USUBJID", "TRTA", "AEDECOD", "AEBODSYS"],
        description="Columns required in the analysis dataset for this spec.",
    )

    Each ``OverallStat`` emits a flat ARD row with ``variable=""`` and

    filter: Any | None = Field(

        description=(
            "Optional Polars expression to subset the dataset before "
            "counting.  ``None`` means count all subjects."

    statistics: list[Statistic] | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Per-row stat override.  ``None`` inherits from the parent spec's ``statistics`` list."
        ),
    )

    ARD utilities¶

    fleet.tlg ¶

    TLG (Tables, Listings, Graphs) Polars namespace extension.

    Registers df.tlg on every Polars DataFrame. Sub-structures are accessed via properties: - df.tlg.ae — AE summary tables and listings - df.tlg.vs — Vital-signs summary tables

    Usage¶

    import fleet

ard = adae.tlg.ae.t_summary(groupby="TRTA", adsl=adsl)

    TLGBuilder ¶

    This is a shared base class composed into every TLG sub-namespace. Domain-specific defaults (required columns, default statistics, context label) are baked into the sub-namespace rather than the builder.

    class TLGBuilder:
    """Fluent builder for constructing TLG ARDs inline.

    This is a shared base class composed into every TLG sub-namespace.
    Domain-specific defaults (required columns, default statistics,
    ``context`` label) are baked into the sub-namespace rather than the
    builder.

    Args:
        df: The primary analysis DataFrame.
        context: Domain context label (e.g. ``"t_ae_summary"``).
        spec_cls: The spec Pydantic model class for this domain.
        namespace_cls: The namespace class that implements ``t_summary()``.
        defaults: Domain-specific default kwargs for spec construction.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        df: pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        context: str,
        spec_cls: type[TLGSpec],
        namespace_cls: type[Any],
        defaults: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._df = df
        self._context = context
        self._spec_cls = spec_cls
        self._namespace_cls = namespace_cls
        self._defaults: dict[str, Any] = defaults or {}
        self._adsl: pl.DataFrame | None = None
        self._adsl_filter: pl.Expr | None = None
        self._dataset_filter: pl.Expr | None = None
        self._group_col: str | None = None
        self._group2_col: str | None = None
        self._header_rows_list: list[OverallStat] = []
        self._rows_fields: list[str] = []
        self._statistics: list[Statistic] | None = None
        self._pools: list[GroupPool] = []
        self._column_order: list[str] = []
        self._fmt_overrides: dict[str, str] = {}

    def _clone(self) -> TLGBuilder:
        return copy.copy(self)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Data input verbs                                                     #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def population(
        self,
        adsl: pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        adsl_filter: pl.Expr | None = None,
    ) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the ADSL population and optional denominator filter.

        Args:
            adsl: ADSL DataFrame for big-N denominators.
            adsl_filter: Optional filter applied to ADSL only.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with population set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._adsl = adsl
        new._adsl_filter = adsl_filter
        return new

    def filter(self, expr: pl.Expr) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the dataset filter (applied to the primary dataset only).

        Args:
            expr: Polars expression to filter the primary dataset.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with dataset filter set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._dataset_filter = expr
        return new

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Grouping verbs                                                       #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def by(self, col: str) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the primary grouping column (treatment arm).

        Args:
            col: Column name for group1 (e.g. ``"TRTA"``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with group1 set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._group_col = col
        return new

    def by2(self, col: str) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set a secondary grouping column (stratification).

        The column must already exist in the DataFrame (pre-merge from
        ADSL or another dataset before calling the namespace).

        Args:
            col: Column name for group2 (e.g. ``"AGEGR1"``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with group2 set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._group2_col = col
        return new

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Row / stat / format verbs                                            #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def header_rows(self, overall_stats: list[OverallStat]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set header rows (whole-dataset aggregate rows).

        Args:
            overall_stats: List of ``OverallStat`` definitions.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with header rows set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._header_rows_list = list(overall_stats)
        return new

    def rows(self, fields: list[str]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the row hierarchy fields.

        A single field maps to ``variable``.  Two fields drive two-level
        nesting: the first maps to ``variable``, the second to ``group2``.

        Args:
            fields: One or two field names for the row hierarchy.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with row fields set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._rows_fields = list(fields)
        return new

    def stats(self, statistics: list[Statistic]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the statistics to compute.

        Args:
            statistics: List of ``Statistic`` enum values.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with statistics set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._statistics = list(statistics)
        return new

    def pools(self, pool_defs: list[GroupPool]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set pooled treatment group definitions.

        Args:
            pool_defs: List of ``GroupPool`` definitions.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with pools set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._pools = list(pool_defs)
        return new

    def column_order(self, order: list[str]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Set the display column order.

        Args:
            order: Ordered list of arm labels.

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with column order set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._column_order = list(order)
        return new

    def fmt(self, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> TLGBuilder:
        """Override per-stat format specifiers.

        Args:
            mapping: Dict mapping stat_name to format string
                (e.g. ``{"mean": "xx.xx"}``).

        Returns:
            TLGBuilder: Builder with format overrides set.
        """
        new = self._clone()
        new._fmt_overrides = dict(mapping)
        return new

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Materialisation                                                      #
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def to_spec(self) -> TLGSpec:
        """Serialise accumulated builder state to the equivalent spec.

        Returns:
            TLGSpec: A spec instance matching the builder configuration.
        """
        from ._specs import Row

        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(self._defaults)

        if self._adsl_filter is not None:
            kwargs["adsl_filter"] = self._adsl_filter
        if self._dataset_filter is not None:
            kwargs["dataset_filter"] = self._dataset_filter
        if self._header_rows_list:
            kwargs["header_rows"] = self._header_rows_list
        if self._rows_fields:
            kwargs["rows"] = [Row(field=f) for f in self._rows_fields]
        if self._statistics is not None:
            kwargs["statistics"] = self._statistics
        if self._pools:
            kwargs["pools"] = self._pools
        if self._column_order:
            kwargs["column_order"] = self._column_order

        return self._spec_cls(**kwargs)

    def to_ard(self) -> pl.DataFrame:
        """Materialise the builder to an ARD DataFrame.

        Constructs the equivalent spec and delegates to the domain
        namespace's ``t_summary()`` method.

        Returns:
            pl.DataFrame: Long-format {cards}-compatible ARD.

        Examples:
            Inline AE summary::

                ard = (
                    adae.tlg.ae
                    .population(adsl, adsl_filter=pl.col("SAFFL") == "Y")
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                    .to_ard()
                )
        """
        spec = self.to_spec()
        ns = self._namespace_cls(self._df)
        return ns.t_summary(
            groupby=self._group_col,
            adsl=self._adsl,
            spec=spec,
        )

    def to_html(
        self,
        path: str | Path | None = None,
        *,
        metadata: RenderMetadata | None = None,
        html_wrapper: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Render the builder result as a pharma-style HTML table.

        Materialises the ARD via ``.to_ard()``, shapes it into a
        ``TableModel``, and renders to HTML.

        Args:
            path: Optional file path.  If given, HTML is written to disk.
            metadata: Optional ``RenderMetadata`` for title, subtitle,
                footnotes, etc.
            html_wrapper: Optional HTML template with ``{table}``
                placeholder for injection.

        Returns:
            str: The rendered HTML string.

        Examples:
            Inline AE summary to HTML::

                html = (
                    adae.tlg.ae
                    .population(adsl)
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                    .to_html(metadata=RenderMetadata(title="Table 14.3.1"))
                )
        """
        from pathlib import Path as _Path

        from .render._models import RenderMetadata as _RM
        from .render._models import ard_to_table_model
        from .render.html import render_html

        ard = self.to_ard()
        meta = metadata or _RM()
        model = ard_to_table_model(ard, meta)
        html = render_html(model, html_wrapper=html_wrapper)

        if path is not None:
            p = _Path(path)
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")

        return html

    def to_pdf(
        self,
        path: str | Path,
        *,
        metadata: RenderMetadata | None = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """Render the builder result as a PDF file via WeasyPrint.

        Args:
            path: Output PDF file path.
            metadata: Optional ``RenderMetadata`` for title, subtitle,
                footnotes, etc.

        Returns:
            Path: The written PDF path.

        Raises:
            ImportError: If WeasyPrint is not installed.

        Examples:
            Inline AE summary to PDF::

                path = (
                    adae.tlg.ae
                    .population(adsl)
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                    .to_pdf("ae_summary.pdf",
                            metadata=RenderMetadata(title="Table 14.3.1"))
                )
        """

        from .render._models import RenderMetadata as _RM
        from .render._models import ard_to_table_model
        from .render.pdf import render_pdf

        ard = self.to_ard()
        meta = metadata or _RM()
        model = ard_to_table_model(ard, meta)
        return render_pdf(model, path)

    def to_pptx(
        self,
        path: str | Path,
        *,
        metadata: RenderMetadata | None = None,
        theme: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """Render the builder result as an editable PPTX slide deck.

        Args:
            path: Output ``.pptx`` file path.
            metadata: Optional ``RenderMetadata`` for title, subtitle,
                footnotes, etc.
            theme: Optional dict of style overrides (font, colours, sizes).

        Returns:
            Path: The written ``.pptx`` path.

        Raises:
            ImportError: If ``python-pptx`` is not installed.

        Examples:
            Inline AE summary to editable slides::

                path = (
                    adae.tlg.ae
                    .population(adsl)
                    .by("TRTA")
                    .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                    .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                    .to_pptx("ae_summary.pptx",
                             metadata=RenderMetadata(title="Table 14.3.1"))
                )
        """

        from .render._models import RenderMetadata as _RM
        from .render._models import ard_to_table_model
        from .render.slides import render_pptx

        ard = self.to_ard()
        meta = metadata or _RM()
        model = ard_to_table_model(ard, meta)
        return render_pptx(model, path, theme=theme)

    def to_spec(self) -> TLGSpec:
    """Serialise accumulated builder state to the equivalent spec.

    Returns:
        TLGSpec: A spec instance matching the builder configuration.
    """
    from ._specs import Row

    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(self._defaults)

    if self._adsl_filter is not None:
        kwargs["adsl_filter"] = self._adsl_filter
    if self._dataset_filter is not None:
        kwargs["dataset_filter"] = self._dataset_filter
    if self._header_rows_list:
        kwargs["header_rows"] = self._header_rows_list
    if self._rows_fields:
        kwargs["rows"] = [Row(field=f) for f in self._rows_fields]
    if self._statistics is not None:
        kwargs["statistics"] = self._statistics
    if self._pools:
        kwargs["pools"] = self._pools
    if self._column_order:
        kwargs["column_order"] = self._column_order

    return self._spec_cls(**kwargs)

        Inline AE summary::

            ard = (
                adae.tlg.ae
                .population(adsl, adsl_filter=pl.col("SAFFL") == "Y")
                .by("TRTA")
                .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                .to_ard()
            )
    """
    spec = self.to_spec()
    ns = self._namespace_cls(self._df)
    return ns.t_summary(
        groupby=self._group_col,
        adsl=self._adsl,
        spec=spec,
    )

    def to_html(
    self,
    path: str | Path | None = None,
    *,
    metadata: RenderMetadata | None = None,
    html_wrapper: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Render the builder result as a pharma-style HTML table.

    Materialises the ARD via ``.to_ard()``, shapes it into a
    ``TableModel``, and renders to HTML.

    Args:
        path: Optional file path.  If given, HTML is written to disk.
        metadata: Optional ``RenderMetadata`` for title, subtitle,
            footnotes, etc.
        html_wrapper: Optional HTML template with ``{table}``
            placeholder for injection.

    Returns:
        str: The rendered HTML string.

    Examples:
        Inline AE summary to HTML::

            html = (
                adae.tlg.ae
                .population(adsl)
                .by("TRTA")
                .rows(["AEBODSYS", "AEDECOD"])
                .stats([Statistic.N_SUBJECTS, Statistic.N_PCT])
                .to_html(metadata=RenderMetadata(title="Table 14.3.1"))
            )
    """
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    from .render._models import RenderMetadata as _RM
    from .render._models import ard_to_table_model
    from .render.html import render_html

    ard = self.to_ard()
    meta = metadata or _RM()
    model = ard_to_table_model(ard, meta)
    html = render_html(model, html_wrapper=html_wrapper)

    if path is not None:
        p = _Path(path)
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")

    return html

    class TLGSpec(BaseModel):
    """Base specification for all TLG outputs.

    Subclasses define output-type-specific defaults and required
    columns.  Every field below is also settable inline through the
    fluent [`TLGBuilder`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder] — the cross-references
    in each field's description point to the matching builder method.
    """

    output_type: str = Field(
        default="base",
        description=(
            "Discriminator distinguishing summary vs listing layouts. "
            "Subclasses override this default."
        ),
    )
    adsl_filter: Any | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Polars expression filtering ADSL before subject counting. "
            "Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.population()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.population]."
        ),
    )
    dataset_filter: Any | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Polars expression filtering the analysis dataset (e.g. ADAE).  "
            "Set inline via [`TLGBuilder.filter()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.filter]."
        ),
    )
    header_rows: list[OverallStat] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description=(
            "Whole-dataset aggregate rows rendered above the hierarchy.  "
            "Set inline via "
            "[`TLGBuilder.header_rows()`][fleet.tlg.TLGBuilder.header_rows]."
        ),
    )
    required_columns: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description=(
            "Columns that must be present in the dataset; checked by :meth:`validate_dataframe`."
        ),
    )
    required_flags: dict[str, list[str]] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description=(
            "Per-column lists of values that must be present in the data "
            "(content validation).  Empty by default."
        ),
    )

    model_config = {"extra": "forbid", "arbitrary_types_allowed": True}

    def validate_dataframe(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        """Run structural + content validation against *df*.

        Raises:
            SchemaError: If required columns are missing, required flag
                values are absent, or other data constraints are violated.
        """
        self._validate_structural(df)
        self._validate_content(df)

    def _validate_structural(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        """Tier 1: check required columns exist."""
        available = set(df.columns)
        missing = [c for c in self.required_columns if c not in available]
        if missing:
            raise SchemaError(
                f"{self.__class__.__name__} requires columns {self.required_columns} "
                f"but DataFrame is missing {missing}. "
                f"Available: {sorted(available)}"
            )

    def _validate_content(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> None:
        """Tier 2: check required flag/PARAMCD values exist in data."""
        for col, required_vals in self.required_flags.items():
            if col not in df.columns:
                raise SchemaError(
                    f"{self.__class__.__name__} requires column '{col}' for "
                    f"content validation but it is missing."
                )
            actual = set(df[col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())
            missing = [v for v in required_vals if v not in actual]
            if missing:
                raise SchemaError(
                    f"{self.__class__.__name__} requires {col} values "
                    f"{required_vals} but data is missing {missing}. "
                    f"Available: {sorted(actual)}"
                )

    def check(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> list[str]:
        """Pre-validation diagnostic — returns warnings without raising.

        Args:
            df: The DataFrame to check.

        Returns:
            list[str]: Diagnostic messages (empty if all checks pass).
        """
        diagnostics: list[str] = []
        available = set(df.columns)
        missing = [c for c in self.required_columns if c not in available]
        if missing:
            diagnostics.append(
                f"MISSING COLUMNS: {missing} required by {self.__class__.__name__} are not present."
            )
        for col, required_vals in self.required_flags.items():
            if col not in available:
                diagnostics.append(f"MISSING FLAG COLUMN: '{col}' not in DataFrame.")
            else:
                actual = set(df[col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())
                absent = [v for v in required_vals if v not in actual]
                if absent:
                    diagnostics.append(f"MISSING VALUES: {col} missing {absent}.")
        return diagnostics

    def to_yaml(self) -> str:
        """Serialize this spec to a YAML string.

        Returns:
            str: YAML representation of the spec.
        """
        data = self.model_dump(exclude_none=True, exclude_defaults=False)
        # Remove filter fields (not YAML-serializable as Polars Expr)
        data.pop("adsl_filter", None)
        data.pop("dataset_filter", None)
        # Remove header_rows filters (Polars Expr)
        for hr in data.get("header_rows", []):
            hr.pop("filter", None)
        # Convert enums to their values
        data = _enum_to_value(data)
        return yaml.dump(data, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False)

    @classmethod
    def from_yaml(cls, yaml_str: str) -> TLGSpec:
        """Deserialize a spec from a YAML string.

        Args:
            yaml_str: YAML text.

        Returns:
            TLGSpec: The reconstructed spec instance.
        """
        data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_str)
        return cls.model_validate(data)

        SchemaError: If required columns are missing, required flag
            values are absent, or other data constraints are violated.
    """
    self._validate_structural(df)
    self._validate_content(df)

    def check(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> list[str]:
    """Pre-validation diagnostic — returns warnings without raising.

    Args:
        df: The DataFrame to check.

    Returns:
        list[str]: Diagnostic messages (empty if all checks pass).
    """
    diagnostics: list[str] = []
    available = set(df.columns)
    missing = [c for c in self.required_columns if c not in available]
    if missing:
        diagnostics.append(
            f"MISSING COLUMNS: {missing} required by {self.__class__.__name__} are not present."
        )
    for col, required_vals in self.required_flags.items():
        if col not in available:
            diagnostics.append(f"MISSING FLAG COLUMN: '{col}' not in DataFrame.")
        else:
            actual = set(df[col].drop_nulls().unique().to_list())
            absent = [v for v in required_vals if v not in actual]
            if absent:
                diagnostics.append(f"MISSING VALUES: {col} missing {absent}.")
    return diagnostics

    def to_yaml(self) -> str:
    """Serialize this spec to a YAML string.

    Returns:
        str: YAML representation of the spec.
    """
    data = self.model_dump(exclude_none=True, exclude_defaults=False)
    # Remove filter fields (not YAML-serializable as Polars Expr)
    data.pop("adsl_filter", None)
    data.pop("dataset_filter", None)
    # Remove header_rows filters (Polars Expr)
    for hr in data.get("header_rows", []):
        hr.pop("filter", None)
    # Convert enums to their values
    data = _enum_to_value(data)
    return yaml.dump(data, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False)

    @classmethod
def from_yaml(cls, yaml_str: str) -> TLGSpec:
    """Deserialize a spec from a YAML string.

    Args:
        yaml_str: YAML text.

    Returns:
        TLGSpec: The reconstructed spec instance.
    """
    data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_str)
    return cls.model_validate(data)
